purpose: Provide an optional text, voice, reading, and media-enjoyment surface for a more capable computer without changing the safe single-session defaults.

notes: These values are planning guidance, not a compatibility guarantee.
The runtime measures physical RAM and may reduce the effective group capacity.
GPU and VRAM availability do not prove that local models, drivers, voice packs, or decoders are installed.

capabilities.boundary: Capacity remains RAM-capped, each person keeps a separate session, and voice replies use the existing ordered queue.
Uses a separate portable index and paced reading records; it does not replace the resident private index or create memory automatically.
Only files present in the selected index can be opened. Playback and presentation do not prove attention, understanding, or completion.
The existing loopback ASR sidecar is owner-started, microphone capture starts off, and raw audio is not a durable media library item.
The existing transient one-still path is bounded, non-identifying, and not continuous video understanding.
Depends on compatible local models, voice packs, GPU/VRAM, drivers, and available resources; generic OS voice may be used where separately supported.
No continuous visual interpretation or identity recognition is enabled.
This launcher uses the existing text and voice surface. It does not grant a body or prove multi-body world rendering.
Long-session reading remains paced and reviewable; no launcher may claim a work was enjoyed, understood, or completed without grounded session evidence.
